name: P'ei Ti
bio: P'ei Ti, a friend of the poet Wang Wei, is dated only as “9th century” in the chronology of poets printed in The Jade Mountain. His poem here is a farewell to a friend.
The poem here is Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu's versions in The Jade Mountain (1929), given with the poet's name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A Farewell to Ts'uêi
poems.author: P'ei Ti
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Though you think to return to this maze of mountains,
Oh, let them brim your heart with wonder! . . .
Remember the fisherman from Wu-ling
Who had only a day in the Peach-Blossom Country.

poems.title: 崔九欲往南山馬上口號與別 (Cui jiu yu wang nan shan ma shang kou hao yu bie)
poems.author: P'ei Ti
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.note: 五言絕句. Also titled 留別王維; 送崔九.
poems.text:
歸山深淺去，須盡丘壑美。
莫學武陵人，暫遊桃源裏。
